title: Requirements for an NBI clearance
content: As of 2026-10-07, you bring three items to the NBI branch. 1. Your printed or digital reference number or QR code. 2. Your proof of payment or receipt. 3. Two valid government-issued IDs. The page gives these examples of IDs: passport, driver's license, national ID, UMID, postal ID, or a PSA birth certificate. Staff take your digital photo, fingerprints, and electronic signature at the branch. Source: https://nbi.gov.ph/how-to-apply-nbi-clearance/ (checked 2026-10-07).

title: Where the DFA lists passport requirements
content: As of 2026-10-07, the DFA lists the documents for a passport application on its requirements page at consular.dfa.gov.ph/services/passport/requirements. The passport.gov.ph site links to that page and to the passport FAQ. This record does not copy the list, because the requirements page blocked the fetch on 2026-10-07. Bring the documents that page lists for your case: new application or renewal, adult or minor. Appointments are free and run only through passport.gov.ph. Source: https://passport.gov.ph/ (checked 2026-10-07).
